crossRefs.note: Shall not his majesty make you afraid, and his dread fall on you?
“Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:
Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.
Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.
“Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.
Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?
“Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;
crossRefs.keyword: but it is not so with me. Heb. but I am not so with myself

translations.web: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;
translations.bsb: Let Him remove His rod from me, so that His terror will no longer frighten me.
translations.kjv: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify
translations.asv: Let him take his rod away from me, And let not his terror make me afraid:
